606 Redbud Drive
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$275,000, 5 bed, 2.50 bath, 2,060 SF, MLS# 603107

This lovely five bedroom home with 2.5BA is just the home for you. Located on a cul-de-sac on the outskirts of Cove with an oversized lot will allow plenty of room for your children to play!
The master bedroom with an ensuite bath ensures privacy. The large walk-in closet has room to spare!
The other four bedrooms are upstairs and are all good size. The living area on the first floor has a wood burning fireplace for either warmth or ambiance. The kitchen is spacious and has a pantry. The dining area is open to the family room. This home is located within minutes of the HWY 9 bypass to Killeen, which makes a commute to Ft Hood a bit easier.  Call your favorite realtor today to make this home yours!

2 full bath, 1 half bath
